answer: Peers vouch, yet the scheduler picks who vouches. Each epoch a beacon-derived shuffle pairs answers with reviewers and refuses to cluster two identities that share a funding path or past co-attestation. A sybil ring cannot approve itself; it needs outsiders with clean histories, drawn at random from a capped, accuracy-weighted pool. Ten thousand puppets still need ten thousand edges into honest nodes, each edge taking months of clean work. A violet tag marks any cluster that broke the distance rule. You may wander in, but boarding happens at a jetty somebody else earned.
